dimension_justifications.soundness: Bounded claims have coherent complementary evidence, but the primary run lacks clean terminal closure, most tensors are digest-only, and provenance stops above compiled Triton.
dimension_justifications.presentation: Estimands, cohort boundaries, unsupported claims, and denominators are unusually explicit.
dimension_justifications.contribution: Useful integration, but established components and one model/runtime/schedule/geometry.

paper_summary: ForkAudit provides a phase-aware ownership and provenance audit for hybrid KV/GDN inference in one Qwen reference case.
strongest_verified_contribution: Direct post-transition GDN base/peer disjointness across the factorial, including N=1.
questions: Can a complete fresh run close terminal audit?
What exact software/kernel environment produced RR2?
Can the inputs and oracle selection be reconstructed?

issues.observed_evidence: No execution combines the primary GPU results with a successful terminal closure audit.
issues.why_it_matters: The central contribution is fail-closed and executable.
issues.required_fix: Rerun the complete corrected workflow or sharply distinguish scientific execution from separately validated packaging.
issues.verification_test: Fresh extraction must complete GPU execution, aggregation, replay, cleanup, and manifest audit.
issues.evidence_needed: Complete clean-run log and final manifest.

issues.observed_evidence: Callable provenance stops at Python module/name/signature and does not fingerprint compiled kernel/autotuning selection.
issues.why_it_matters: The same Python callable can dispatch different compiled implementations.
issues.required_fix: Either publish compiled-kernel/autotune receipts and full environment lock or consistently rename the target to Python-level dispatch provenance.
issues.verification_test: Reconstruct environment or complete a wording audit; verify all arms share the declared provenance level.
issues.evidence_needed: Environment lock and receipts, or narrowed wording.

issues.observed_evidence: Most tensors are digest-only and offline replay verifies receipts rather than regenerating live execution.
issues.why_it_matters: This limits independent falsifiability of exactness and ownership.
issues.required_fix: Provide a clean regeneration path and canonical values/traces for a stratified subset.
issues.verification_test: Independent execution regenerates token, logit, KV, GDN, and ownership records without consuming booleans.
issues.evidence_needed: Independent rerun and representative raw values.

issues.observed_evidence: The PDF omits a human-auditable dataset/tokenizer lineage table.
issues.why_it_matters: Frozen token IDs alone do not verify PG-19 provenance.
issues.required_fix: Release source revision, stable IDs/hashes, tokenizer files/revision, offsets, and construction command.
issues.verification_test: Reconstruct all eight token banks from source.

issues.observed_evidence: The deterministic oracle-row selection and threshold plan are not exposed in the PDF.
issues.required_fix: Publish the immutable pre-execution plan, row derivation, timestamp/hash, and tolerance rationale.
issues.verification_test: Derive rows and threshold before opening outputs and recompute all values.
